items.title: Billy Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: eventually it became my band. And then Thad Jones and Elvin Jones and Tommy Flanagan came in after that

ctx.x: I came here in ‘48. I worked with Lucky and Lunceford, and then I think Milton Butler’s big band, and then Walter Fuller, who had been Dizzy’s arranger and in his band. And then I left here and my father died, and I went back to Detroit in February of ‘49. And then I left there when I went to join Woody Herman somewhere in September or October of ‘49 or something like that. And I stayed out there a couple of months with Woody Herman. Then I came back to Detroit and started a band at a place called Blue Bird Inn…
